```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(gopheR)
library(knitr)
library(reactable)

# Set database path
db_path <- normalizePath(file.path("..", "extdata"))
options(gopheR.db_path = db_path)
options(gopheR.db_file = "gopherDen_db.sqlite")
```

## Assembly Overview

This page shows all metagenome assemblies in the database with their statistics and provenance.

```{r assembly-data}
# Get all assemblies
assemblies <- gopheR::with_gopher_con(function(con) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT
      o.object_id,
      o.object_subtype,
      o.label,
      o.description,
      o.created_at
    FROM object o
    WHERE o.object_type = 'assembly'
    ORDER BY o.object_id
  ")
})

# Get assembly statistics from results
assembly_results <- gopheR::with_gopher_con(function(con) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT
      r.object_id,
      r.key,
      r.value
    FROM result r
    WHERE r.object_id IN (
      SELECT object_id FROM object WHERE object_type = 'assembly'
    )
  ")
})

# Pivot results wide
if (nrow(assembly_results) > 0) {
  assembly_results_wide <- assembly_results |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = key,
      values_from = value,
      values_fn = first
    )

  assemblies_full <- assemblies |>
    left_join(assembly_results_wide, by = "object_id")
} else {
  assemblies_full <- assemblies
}
```

## Assembly Table

```{r assembly-table}
# Only mutate columns that exist
if ("size_bp" %in% colnames(assemblies_full)) {
  assemblies_display <- assemblies_full |>
    mutate(
      size_bp = as.numeric(size_bp),
      n_contigs = as.numeric(n_contigs),
      N50 = as.numeric(N50),
      gc_content = as.numeric(gc_content)
    )
} else {
  assemblies_display <- assemblies_full
}

# Build column definitions dynamically
col_defs <- list(
  object_id = colDef(name = "Assembly ID", minWidth = 120),
  object_subtype = colDef(name = "Type", minWidth = 120),
  label = colDef(name = "Label", minWidth = 150),
  description = colDef(name = "Description", minWidth = 200),
  created_at = colDef(name = "Created", minWidth = 180)
)

# Add optional columns if they exist
if ("size_bp" %in% colnames(assemblies_display)) {
  col_defs$size_bp <- colDef(
    name = "Size (bp)",
    format = colFormat(separators = TRUE, digits = 0)
  )
}
if ("n_contigs" %in% colnames(assemblies_display)) {
  col_defs$n_contigs <- colDef(name = "Contigs", format = colFormat(digits = 0))
}
if ("N50" %in% colnames(assemblies_display)) {
  col_defs$N50 <- colDef(name = "N50", format = colFormat(separators = TRUE, digits = 0))
}
if ("gc_content" %in% colnames(assemblies_display)) {
  col_defs$gc_content <- colDef(name = "GC %", format = colFormat(digits = 1))
}

reactable(
  assemblies_display,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 20,
  columns = col_defs
)
```

## Assembly Provenance

```{r assembly-provenance}
# Get readsets used for each assembly
assembly_readsets <- gopheR::with_gopher_con(function(con) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT
      e.child_id as assembly_id,
      e.parent_id as readset_id
    FROM edge e
    WHERE e.edge_type = 'assembled_from'
      AND e.child_id IN (
        SELECT object_id FROM object WHERE object_type = 'assembly'
      )
  ")
})

# Count readsets per assembly
assembly_readset_counts <- assembly_readsets |>
  count(assembly_id, name = "n_readsets")

# Get MAGs binned from each assembly
assembly_mags <- gopheR::with_gopher_con(function(con) {
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "
    SELECT
      e.parent_id as assembly_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT e.child_id) as n_mags
    FROM edge e
    WHERE e.edge_type = 'binned_from'
      AND e.parent_id IN (
        SELECT object_id FROM object WHERE object_type = 'assembly'
      )
    GROUP BY e.parent_id
  ")
})

# Combine
assembly_summary <- assemblies |>
  left_join(assembly_readset_counts, by = c("object_id" = "assembly_id")) |>
  left_join(assembly_mags, by = c("object_id" = "assembly_id")) |>
  replace_na(list(n_readsets = 0, n_mags = 0)) |>
  select(object_id, label, n_readsets, n_mags)

kable(assembly_summary,
      col.names = c("Assembly ID", "Label", "Readsets Used", "MAGs Binned"),
      caption = "Assembly connections to other objects")
```

## Assembly Statistics

```{r assembly-stats}
if ("size_bp" %in% colnames(assemblies_full)) {
  assemblies_full |>
    mutate(size_mb = as.numeric(size_bp) / 1e6) |>
    filter(!is.na(size_mb)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = size_mb)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "#2c7fb8", alpha = 0.7, color = "white") +
    labs(
      title = "Assembly Size Distribution",
      x = "Assembly Size (Mb)",
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
} else {
  cat("No assembly size data available.")
}
```

## Contig Statistics

```{r contig-stats}
if ("n_contigs" %in% colnames(assemblies_full) && "N50" %in% colnames(assemblies_full)) {
  assemblies_full |>
    mutate(
      n_contigs = as.numeric(n_contigs),
      N50 = as.numeric(N50)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(n_contigs), !is.na(N50)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = n_contigs, y = N50)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7, color = "#2c7fb8") +
    scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
    scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(
      title = "Assembly Quality: N50 vs Number of Contigs",
      subtitle = "Higher N50 and fewer contigs indicate better assembly",
      x = "Number of Contigs (log scale)",
      y = "N50 (log scale)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray40")
    )
} else {
  cat("No contig statistics available.")
}
```

## MAGs per Assembly

```{r mags-per-assembly}
if (nrow(assembly_mags) > 0) {
  assembly_mags |>
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(assembly_id, n_mags), y = n_mags)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2c7fb8", alpha = 0.8) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "MAGs Binned per Assembly",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of MAGs"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
} else {
  cat("No MAG binning data available.")
}
```
